name: fix-vee-plucker
title: Fix vee - unify with standard Plücker meet formula
description: Fix vee() Plücker line-from-planes meet formula; current implementation doesn't match standard meet or emission formulas
creator: denkijin
notes: Unified all three implementations (lib.rs:50-63, emit.rs:9-18, emit_cuda.rs:17-27) to standard Plücker meet formula for two points: M = p×q (moment), D = p_w*q - q_w*p (direction). CUDA emission limited to 4 components (float4) but computes correct values. Library compiles and passes type-check.
